reviewScope: Optional notes for package-specific semantics and intentional integration differences. Existing implementation notes were collected during the DS-22/23 audit and subsequent migrations; they are not a complete or continuously required review. Native DOM behavior is documented by React and the underlying primitives. New components and props do not require policy entries.

variant.meaning: A named visual recipe within a component family. The word alone does not imply status or identical values across families.
variant.migration: Keep established family-specific values when they express different concepts. Introduce a named replacement plus a deprecation path only when the same concept is represented inconsistently.

tone.meaning: Semantic communication such as information, success, warning, or danger. Decorative identity hues and categorical chart series are distinct concepts.
tone.migration: Do not rename decorative Avatar.variant or chart category colors to status tone. Check the component's allowed subset instead of adding every tone everywhere.

size.meaning: Family-relative geometry or density. Button height, Avatar diameter, text scale, and Empty composition are not one common pixel scale.
size.migration: Preserve intentional family scales and document their dimensions. Do not globally replace small/medium with one abbreviated enum or reinterpret layout choices as fixed heights.

width/height.meaning: Physical or constrained layout dimensions; literal numbers and named presets require the owning component's units and meaning.
width/height.migration: Do not collapse a dialog's width preset into the control size axis. Existing numeric layout APIs retain CSS pixel semantics where documented.

id/ids.meaning: An inherited DOM id identifies an element for labels, descriptions, and focus. Record keys or a displayed list of identifiers are data and must be described as such.
id/ids.migration: Do not replace domain identifiers with DOM ids or route DOM integration props to a hidden input when the visible trigger owns the accessible relationship.

action/actions.meaning: Usually rendered action content. A function-valued prop instead needs its explicit invocation and ownership contract; inspect the type before assuming either meaning.
action/actions.migration: Keep ReactNode/ReactElement slots composable. Do not turn a slot into an event callback under the same name; introduce a distinct handler API if needed.

empty.meaning: Content or configuration shown when data is absent. String fallback, ReactNode slot, and structured recovery state are different contracts.
empty.migration: Retain the smallest useful contract for each component. No blanket rename or widening to a function/ReactNode without checking rendering and accessibility.

icon.meaning: An icon constructor and a preconstructed element are distinct APIs. Before/after positions are explicit slots; a semantic icon may be provided by the component.
icon.migration: Preserve Banner's typed constructor override and Button's element slots. Any future unification needs a new adapter or deprecated compatibility path, with sizing and decorative accessibility preserved.

change-handlers.meaning: Native onChange receives a DOM event; domain controls may report a value; Radix adapters use onValueChange/onCheckedChange. Closing requests and async saves are separate operations.
change-handlers.migration: Do not rename every callback to onChange. Preserve payloads, optionality, controlled/uncontrolled ownership, and promise/rejection behavior when proposing replacements.

appearance.meaning: Family-specific presentation treatment, such as Badge fill emphasis or Spinner foreground treatment. Distinct from semantic tone; values need not match unrelated components.
appearance.migration: Preserve established family recipes and their interaction with tone/variant. A shared name is not grounds for merging different visual concepts.

value/defaultValue/checked/open.meaning: May be caller-controlled state, uncontrolled initialization, native form metadata or display-only data. Each component review identifies ownership and payload; presence of a value prop alone does not imply a controlled input.
value/defaultValue/checked/open.migration: Preserve controlled/uncontrolled boundaries and reset behavior. Do not repurpose displayed values or native event handlers as semantic state APIs.

Absent.domTarget: Fixed span containing an em dash; no prop forwarding.
Absent.controlledBehavior: Stateless presentation. The caller owns content and any controls supplied as children; no implicit value, checked or selected state.
Absent.defaultBehavior: Always renders an em dash in subtlest text; typography inherits.

ActionBar.domTarget: Outer sticky div containing RecordHeader, h1 and buttons. No arbitrary DOM props or ref are accepted. id is displayed in the breadcrumb, not forwarded as an HTML id.
ActionBar.controlledBehavior: Caller owns state facts, controls and action outcomes; the bar only invokes action.onSelect. Blocked actions render native disabled buttons.
ActionBar.defaultBehavior: Omitted actions render no controls; empty states render no facts. The first state is a Badge and later states use Indicator; control overrides use nullish fallback. primary omitted is secondary; truthy blocked strings disable the action and display its reason. tabs selects bottom-padding/border layout. Legacy breadcrumb overrides crumbs/id through RecordHeader.

actions.meaning: Array of labeled action descriptors, unlike the ReactNode actions slots elsewhere. Each invokes onSelect; primary changes emphasis; a truthy blocked reason disables it.
actions.migration: Preserve descriptor payload and blocked reasons. The one-primary rule is caller guidance, not enforced; use a new API rather than silently treating actions as ReactNode.

id.meaning: Rendered record identifier, not an HTML id or label-target attribute.
id.migration: Keep domain identity as visible content; use underlying primitives when DOM attribute/ref integration is required.

Attachment.domTarget: Native div root; DOM attributes, events, className, style and HTMLDivElement ref forwarded. Native title remains a tooltip attribute.
Attachment.controlledBehavior: Stateless presentation of caller-owned state, size and orientation. No upload, removal, preview, selection or disabled-state inference.
Attachment.defaultBehavior: done state, medium size, horizontal orientation. uploading/processing set aria-busy unless explicitly overridden. Idle has a dashed border, error uses danger tokens. No live region or automatic naming.

size.meaning: xsmall/small/medium control padding, text and media geometry. Actions keep their own target size.
size.migration: New Ledger API uses full size names; the unused app shadcn copy uses xs/sm/default.

Attachment.Actions.domTarget: Native div; attributes, events, className, style and ref forwarded to this part.
Attachment.Actions.controlledBehavior: Stateless content and layout. Interactive and asynchronous behavior stays caller-owned.
Attachment.Actions.defaultBehavior: Normal-flow wrapping row, positioned above the card trigger. No controls added or modified.

Attachment.Content.domTarget: Native div; attributes, events, className, style and ref forwarded to this part.
Attachment.Content.controlledBehavior: Stateless content and layout. Interactive and asynchronous behavior stays caller-owned.
Attachment.Content.defaultBehavior: Flexible metadata container; no child inspection or implicit parts.

Attachment.Description.domTarget: Native span; attributes, events, className, style and ref forwarded to this part.
Attachment.Description.controlledBehavior: Stateless content and layout. Interactive and asynchronous behavior stays caller-owned.
Attachment.Description.defaultBehavior: Small subtle wrapping metadata; danger text under error state. No announcement imposed.

Attachment.Group.domTarget: Native div; attributes, events, className, style and ref forwarded to this part.
Attachment.Group.controlledBehavior: Stateless content and layout. Interactive and asynchronous behavior stays caller-owned.
Attachment.Group.defaultBehavior: Horizontal overflow with visible scrollbar, proximity snapping and focus-outline space. No roles, accessible name or tabIndex imposed.

Attachment.Media.domTarget: Native div; attributes, events, className, style and ref forwarded to this part.
Attachment.Media.controlledBehavior: Stateless content and layout. Interactive and asynchronous behavior stays caller-owned.
Attachment.Media.defaultBehavior: Icon variant by default; image variant crops direct img children. No MIME inference, fetching or broken-image fallback.

variant.meaning: icon or image media presentation, independent of upload state.
variant.migration: Supply the icon/image element; use image alt text or explicit aria-hidden for decorative media.

Attachment.Title.domTarget: Native span; attributes, events, className, style and ref forwarded to this part.
Attachment.Title.controlledBehavior: Stateless content and layout. Interactive and asynchronous behavior stays caller-owned.
Attachment.Title.defaultBehavior: Single-line truncated filename; native title is forwarded. No heading, animation or generated accessible association.

Attachment.Action.domTarget: IconButton action target; native button by default.
Attachment.Action.controlledBehavior: Delegates activation, disabled and loading behavior to IconButton.
Attachment.Action.defaultBehavior: subtle, small. Required label names the control and tooltip; icon is decorative.

icon.meaning: The icon, passed bare; the button sizes it.

size.meaning: `small` (28px) is the default, for toolbars and rows; `medium` (32px) sits beside medium controls.

variant.meaning: `secondary` is the raised button; `subtle` sits in toolbars and rows; `primary` is the bold fill, for the chevron of a primary split button.

Attachment.Trigger.domTarget: Card-wide Button action. Navigation uses a styled anchor.
Attachment.Trigger.controlledBehavior: Disabled uses Button activation guards; preview behavior remains caller-owned.
Attachment.Trigger.defaultBehavior: type=button; caller supplies the accessible name and action. Focus outline follows card bounds.

Badge.domTarget: Native span by default, with native attributes, events, styles and HTMLSpanElement ref. Base UI render accepts an element or callback; a custom component must forward merged props/ref. Anchor-specific attributes and anchor refs belong on the rendered link.
Badge.controlledBehavior: Stateless presentation and composition for labels and statuses. The caller owns content, navigation and any status changes. No selection, checked, disabled, dismissible or live-region behavior is inferred.
Badge.defaultBehavior: variant=default, resolved tone=brand, appearance=bold, size=small (20px). Secondary defaults neutral/subtle; destructive defaults danger/subtle. Explicit tone changes only palette and appearance overrides emphasis for filled treatments. Outline/ghost/link retain their unfilled treatment. xsmall is 16px. All share pill anatomy, icon children or a leading icon shorthand, and data-slot=badge with resolved variant/tone/appearance/size axes. Base UI composes rendered-element props, styles, classes, events and refs.

variant.meaning: Visual treatment: default, secondary, destructive, outline, ghost or link. Variant chooses the default palette and fill emphasis; explicit tone changes palette without changing treatment or geometry.
variant.migration: Use the same Badge for standard and semantic labels. Existing subtle status labels select secondary and retain tone; generic Badge defaults to the shadcn brand/bold treatment.

tone.meaning: Badge palette: brand plus neutral, information, success, warning and danger. Defaults derive from variant. Tone affects color rather than anatomy, density or fill emphasis.
tone.migration: Keep status meaning on Badge. Former neutral labels explicitly choose neutral; the shared Tone type for other families remains unchanged.

appearance.meaning: Optional subtle or bold emphasis for filled variants. Defaults derive from variant. Outline, ghost and link retain their unfilled treatment regardless of appearance.
appearance.migration: Retain explicit bold/subtle status choices on Badge, with secondary selecting the usual subtle status treatment by default.

size.meaning: small (20px) or xsmall (16px) density, independent of palette. All variants and tones use the same pill anatomy.
size.migration: Retain xsmall for dense rows and tabs. The unified Badge uses the shadcn pill shape for statuses as well as generic labels.

icon.meaning: Optional ReactNode rendered before the label as an icon shorthand. Icons can also be explicit children; callers provide accessible text and hide decorative marks.
icon.migration: Keep existing icon content on Badge or compose positioned icon children. No separate status component is required.

Banner.domTarget: div with role alert for danger and status otherwise; no arbitrary DOM/ref forwarding.
Banner.controlledBehavior: Stateless presentation. The caller owns content and any controls supplied as children; no implicit value, checked or selected state.
Banner.defaultBehavior: tone=warning. The icon constructor overrides the tone icon; action is cloned with layout classes. No implicit dismissal or duration.

tone.meaning: Information, warning, or danger for a persistent site-wide condition; success is intentionally absent.
tone.migration: Do not add success only to match Badge's larger status palette.

icon.meaning: Component constructor receiving className; Banner instantiates and sizes it.
icon.migration: Keep this typed override distinct from element-valued icon slots until a deliberate compatibility adapter exists.

action.meaning: One className-capable ReactElement that Banner restyles in its own color.
action.migration: Do not widen to arbitrary ReactNode without changing the cloneElement implementation and preserving action styling.

Bleed.domTarget: The actual as element receives native attributes/events and HTMLElement ref. id remains a DOM id. Polymorphic element choices are restricted to documented semantic tags.
Bleed.controlledBehavior: Stateless presentation. The caller owns content and any controls supplied as children; no implicit value, checked or selected state.
Bleed.defaultBehavior: as=div. No margins without all/inline/block; specified negative spacing comes from tokens. Style prop is intentionally excluded.

Block.domTarget: section containing an h2; no DOM attributes or ref forwarding.
Block.controlledBehavior: Stateless composition; caller owns action control behavior and contents.
Block.defaultBehavior: count is visible for zero and empty string, hidden for null/undefined. Falsy action values render no slot. Children always render inside the standard padded body.

action.meaning: Rendered action content in its named position; the pattern does not clone it or invoke it as a callback.
action.migration: Keep caller-composed controls and their event ownership; do not replace this ReactNode slot with a callback or action configuration.

Box.domTarget: The actual as element receives native attributes/events and HTMLElement ref. id remains a DOM id. Box/Grid accept style; Polymorphic element choices are restricted to documented semantic tags.
Box.controlledBehavior: Stateless presentation. The caller owns content and any controls supplied as children; no implicit value, checked or selected state.
Box.defaultBehavior: as=div. No implicit padding; tokens add classes only when supplied. Background sets surface context. Caller style overrides computed surface variables.

Breadcrumb.domTarget: nav; native props, events, style, className and HTMLElement ref target the navigation landmark.
Breadcrumb.controlledBehavior: Stateless composition. The caller owns navigation, current-page placement, custom controls and any expanded/collapsed trail state.
Breadcrumb.defaultBehavior: Defaults to aria-label=breadcrumb and data-slot=breadcrumb; callers may override native attributes. No implicit ordered list, items or separators. Replace label with aria-label and compose BreadcrumbList explicitly.

BreadcrumbList.domTarget: ol; native props and HTMLOListElement ref target the ordered list.
BreadcrumbList.controlledBehavior: Stateless composition. The caller owns navigation, current-page placement, custom controls and any expanded/collapsed trail state.
BreadcrumbList.defaultBehavior: A wrapping flex list with Ledger small-body typography and subtle text. Callers compose items and decorative separators in order; truncation is no longer automatic.

BreadcrumbItem.domTarget: li; native props and HTMLLIElement ref target the list item, not the nested link or button.
BreadcrumbItem.controlledBehavior: Stateless composition. The caller owns navigation, current-page placement, custom controls and any expanded/collapsed trail state.
BreadcrumbItem.defaultBehavior: An inline-flex list item only. It adds no separator or interactive child. Replace Breadcrumb.Item with BreadcrumbItem containing BreadcrumbLink, BreadcrumbPage or a caller-supplied control.

value.meaning: Native li ordinal value. It does not select a breadcrumb or supply link content.
value.migration: Move former button value to the explicit composed button; use li value only for native ordered-list numbering.

BreadcrumbLink.domTarget: Native anchor by default; anchor props/ref target the link. Base UI render composes a replacement element or custom component that must forward merged props and its ref.
BreadcrumbLink.controlledBehavior: Stateless composition. The caller owns navigation, current-page placement, custom controls and any expanded/collapsed trail state.
BreadcrumbLink.defaultBehavior: Base UI useRender and mergeProps retain rendered-element props, refs and composed events. Default data-slot is breadcrumb-link. Replace asChild with render on this part. No automatic navigation, router dependency, button type or disabled behavior.

BreadcrumbPage.domTarget: span; native props and HTMLSpanElement ref target the current-page text.
BreadcrumbPage.controlledBehavior: Stateless composition. The caller owns navigation, current-page placement, custom controls and any expanded/collapsed trail state.
BreadcrumbPage.defaultBehavior: Defaults to role=link, aria-disabled=true, aria-current=page and data-slot=breadcrumb-page. No href or default tab stop; regular-weight Ledger default text. Native attributes can override defaults.

BreadcrumbSeparator.domTarget: li; native props and HTMLLIElement ref target the decorative separator.
BreadcrumbSeparator.controlledBehavior: Stateless composition. The caller owns navigation, current-page placement, custom controls and any expanded/collapsed trail state.
BreadcrumbSeparator.defaultBehavior: Defaults to role=presentation, aria-hidden=true and data-slot=breadcrumb-separator. Nullish children render a chevron; other children replace it. Insert explicitly between items.

BreadcrumbEllipsis.domTarget: span; native props and HTMLSpanElement ref target the decorative collapsed-path indicator.
BreadcrumbEllipsis.controlledBehavior: Stateless composition. The caller owns navigation, current-page placement, custom controls and any expanded/collapsed trail state.
BreadcrumbEllipsis.defaultBehavior: Defaults to role=presentation, aria-hidden=true and data-slot=breadcrumb-ellipsis; renders the MoreHorizontal icon and hidden More text. No popup, button or collapse state. The caller labels and operates any surrounding interactive control.

Button.domTarget: Native button by default; Base UI render composes action controls. Navigation uses buttonVariants on real links.
Button.controlledBehavior: Caller-owned selected, loading and disabled. Loading preserves focus by default; capture guards block rendered-child activation.
Button.defaultBehavior: secondary, medium (32px), type=button. Existing Ledger variants, sizes and decorative icon options remain.

variant.meaning: Action emphasis: primary, secondary, subtle, danger, or link. danger intentionally combines destructive meaning with the action recipe.
variant.migration: Retain this established action API. Splitting danger into a tone requires an explicit combination matrix and compatibility period, not a global rename.

size.meaning: Control height: xsmall 24px, small 28px, medium 32px; link presentation has automatic height.
size.migration: Keep the documented exception for link rather than claiming size affects every variant identically.

iconBefore.meaning: A rendered ReactElement before the label; the Button owns its display size.
iconBefore.migration: Keep element slots; do not silently change callers to pass icon constructors.

iconAfter.meaning: A rendered ReactElement after the label, commonly a direction or disclosure cue.
iconAfter.migration: Preserve position in the prop name and preserve the accessible label independently.

Card.domTarget: Root HTML div receives the complete ...props spread including id, aria/data attributes and event handlers. ComponentPropsWithoutRef deliberately excludes ref.
Card.controlledBehavior: Stateless surface; no card-level selected/value state or clickable-card behavior.
Card.defaultBehavior: Raised-surface CSS variable is installed by default. Caller style spreads last and can override that variable; className merges through cn. Children are optional; no default child content.

Card.Body.domTarget: Padded div receiving className and children only; no arbitrary DOM props or ref.
Card.Body.defaultBehavior: The fixed p-200 inset applies unless caller className overrides it through cn.

Card.Header.domTarget: div containing an h2, optional description p and action div. Only className is forwarded; no arbitrary DOM props or ref.
Card.Header.controlledBehavior: Stateless header; caller owns rendered actions.
Card.Header.defaultBehavior: Omitted/falsy description and action omit their wrappers. Title always renders as h2.

action.meaning: Rendered action content in its named position; the pattern does not clone it or invoke it as a callback.
action.migration: Keep caller-composed controls and their event ownership; do not replace this ReactNode slot with a callback or action configuration.

Chart.domTarget: figure named by its figcaption title; className targets figure. An expansion Dialog is a sibling. No generic DOM spread/ref contract.
Chart.controlledBehavior: Caller owns status/data/path/actions. Frame owns hidden/highlighted series, table visibility and expanded Dialog; expanded copy has its own Frame state. No controlled props exist for these presentation states.
Chart.defaultBehavior: status=ready, size=medium, swatch=square, texture=false. Locale formatters default; legend is top only for more than one series, otherwise none. data+x+nonempty series enables table twin; downloads and expansion are absent unless requested. height/size sets fallback loading/error/empty height, not child plot geometry. Missing summary/description/path/action/statusText renders no corresponding content; localized status titles fill missing statusTitle.

size.meaning: Preset fallback-state height in this frame. Child plots own their own size; expanding renders a fresh Frame with large fallback height.
size.migration: Preserve this family-specific contract; any replacement must retain payload, units and state ownership.

height.meaning: Fallback-state height in CSS pixels; child plots are not cloned or resized by this prop.
height.migration: Preserve this family-specific contract; any replacement must retain payload, units and state ownership.
height.defaultBehavior: Uses frame size preset if omitted.

actions.meaning: ReactNode toolbar slot next to legend and built-in tools; each action owns its own event and outcome.
actions.migration: Keep a content slot; do not convert actions to an invoked callback.

Chart.Area.domTarget: Plot div (named group or aria-hidden decoration) contains a Recharts SVG and optional portaled details card. className targets the Plot div; no general DOM spread or public ref is supported.
Chart.Area.controlledBehavior: Caller owns data and loading. Frame owns hidden/highlighted series; the plot owns picked details and clears them on dismissal. onSelect reports a selection and does not persist or control selection; details optionally opens the local card.
Chart.Area.defaultBehavior: Props override Frame name, format/formatX, loading, sync and texture; otherwise Frame context wins, then locale formatters, no name, loading=false, no sync and texture=false. Missing label outside Frame makes the plot decorative. Plot geometry defaults to medium=200px independently of Frame size; explicit height overrides size. Missing details/onSelect adds no selection action. Data and series stay caller-owned; optional overlays and labels are absent unless enabled. scale=category, curve=linear, labels=none, baseline=zero, delta=false; stacked/dots/connectNulls false by absence. Area texture follows Frame unless explicitly supplied.

size.meaning: Plot height preset: small=120px, medium=200px, large=320px. It is not control density.
size.migration: Preserve this family-specific contract; any replacement must retain payload, units and state ownership.
size.defaultBehavior: Plot uses medium when omitted; explicit height wins.

height.meaning: Explicit plot height in CSS pixels, overriding the plot size preset.
height.migration: Preserve this family-specific contract; any replacement must retain payload, units and state ownership.

onSelect.meaning: Notification carrying the selected datum/tile/slice/cell payload described by this family; optional details independently owns the local popover.
onSelect.migration: Keep onSelect as a notification; do not reinterpret it as native text selection or a controlled selected-value setter.
onSelect.defaultBehavior: Absent callback is never invoked; a details renderer alone still enables selection.

No line, target or reference is added by default.

Half arc height is size/2+4. name/format/loading/texture inherit Frame; label is visual center content and does not name the chart. Domain derives from numeric cells or [0,1] when absent; format uses locale. showValues defaults true for function-valued status scale, false otherwise. null/undefined values remain empty; optional row/column labels are absent.

Chart.Scatter.defaultBehavior: Props override Frame name, format/formatX, loading, sync and texture; otherwise Frame context wins, then locale formatters, no name, loading=false, no sync and texture=false. Missing label outside Frame makes the plot decorative. Plot geometry defaults to medium=200px independently of Frame size; explicit height overrides size. Missing details/onSelect adds no selection action. Data and series stay caller-owned; optional overlays and labels are absent unless enabled. tone=brand. Groups apply only with both groupBy and a nonempty groups list; otherwise all records form one group. Missing z yields ordinary points; missing name leaves the point unnamed.

size.meaning: Plot height preset: small=120px, medium=200px, large=320px. It is not control density.
size.migration: Preserve this family-specific contract; any replacement must retain payload, units and state ownership.
size.defaultBehavior: Plot uses medium when omitted; explicit height wins.

height.meaning: Explicit plot height in CSS pixels, overriding the plot size preset.
height.migration: Preserve this family-specific contract; any replacement must retain payload, units and state ownership.

onSelect.meaning: Notification carrying the selected datum/tile/slice/cell payload described by this family; optional details independently owns the local popover.
onSelect.migration: Keep onSelect as a notification; do not reinterpret it as native text selection or a controlled selected-value setter.
onSelect.defaultBehavior: Absent callback is never invoked; a details renderer alone still enables selection.

tone.meaning: Chart token color for the ungrouped point set; accepts semantic, brand and categorical chart tones. Explicit groups choose their own tones.
tone.migration: Retain ChartTone; do not narrow to Badge tone or relabel categorical color as semantic status.
tone.defaultBehavior: brand; ignored when explicit groups supply the plotted sets.

Chart.Sparkline.domTarget: Fixed-size div with Recharts SVG; named group or aria-hidden decoration, className targets div. No public ref/general DOM forwarding.

Chart.Sparkline.defaultBehavior: appearance=line, tone=brand, width=96px, height=24px. Missing endDot/reference/x adds no end marker/reference/category key. Named charts receive tooltip and Recharts accessibility; loading draws skeleton at the same dimensions.

appearance.meaning: Mark recipe: line, area or bars, not status or action emphasis.
appearance.migration: Preserve this family-specific contract; any replacement must retain payload, units and state ownership.

tone.meaning: Single series ChartTone including semantic, brand and categorical chart colors.
tone.migration: Preserve this family-specific contract; any replacement must retain payload, units and state ownership.

width.meaning: Fixed CSS pixel width for an inline plot.
width.migration: Preserve this family-specific contract; any replacement must retain payload, units and state ownership.

height.meaning: Fixed CSS pixel height independent of ChartSize.
height.migration: Preserve this family-specific contract; any replacement must retain payload, units and state ownership.

Missing label outside Frame makes the plot decorative. Plot geometry defaults to medium=200px independently of Frame size; explicit height overrides size. Tone inherits the parent, then falls back to categorical index. Unspecified format/name/loading follow Frame.

size.meaning: Plot height preset: small=120px, medium=200px, large=320px. It is not control density.
size.migration: Preserve this family-specific contract; any replacement must retain payload, units and state ownership.
size.defaultBehavior: Plot uses medium when omitted; explicit height wins.

height.meaning: Explicit plot height in CSS pixels, overriding the plot size preset.
height.migration: Preserve this family-specific contract; any replacement must retain payload, units and state ownership.

onSelect.meaning: Notification carrying the selected datum/tile/slice/cell payload described by this family; optional details independently owns the local popover.
onSelect.migration: Keep onSelect as a notification; do not reinterpret it as native text selection or a controlled selected-value setter.
onSelect.defaultBehavior: Absent callback is never invoked; a details renderer alone still enables selection.

CodeBlock.domTarget: Outer div with a named focusable scrolling region and preformatted lines. className reaches outer div; no native/ref prop bag.
CodeBlock.controlledBehavior: Copy button owns temporary copied/failed feedback and announces clipboard rejection. Source lines/copy text remain caller-owned; no editor or selection API.
CodeBlock.defaultBehavior: start=1, maxHeight=560px, wrap=false. Label falls back to localized Code. copy undefined omits the button; an empty copy string still enables copying. Line highlighting is caller-rendered ReactNode content.

ColumnSortable.domTarget: Context provider preserves child structure; DndContext also supplies accessibility live regions/instructions. No wrapper/ref/native DOM API.
ColumnSortable.controlledBehavior: Dnd-kit owns transient drag state. Column drop requests table.setColumnOrder; row drop invokes table meta reorderRows with originals and before/after, leaving data updates to caller. Sortable sets derive ids from the same instance.
ColumnSortable.defaultBehavior: Uses center visible leaf column ids and horizontal sorting strategy; pinned columns excluded.

CommandPalette.domTarget: Portaled Command.Dialog/Radix dialog; its input and listbox/options come from cmdk. There is no root DOM/ref passthrough on the pattern.
CommandPalette.controlledBehavior: Caller owns open; cmdk internally owns search and active-option navigation. Choosing requests onClose before invoking command.run synchronously. Neither callback is awaited or caught; caller owns action failures. useCommandPalette is a separate optional hook with local false initial state and window Cmd/Ctrl+K listener.
CommandPalette.defaultBehavior: Placeholder defaults to Type a command…. Input hint is explicitly null. Empty matching result uses No commands match. Contiguous commands with equal group share a heading; repeated nonadjacent groups remain separate. Unique command ids identify options and group runs; group, label and hint remain searchable keywords.

open.meaning: Required caller-owned open state; no defaultOpen or internal visibility fallback.
open.migration: Keep open and its close request handler together. Do not convert to an uncontrolled defaultOpen without adapting caller state.

onClose.meaning: Requests that the caller close the surface; the function receives no next-state value or DOM event.
onClose.migration: Keep the request callback and caller-owned open state; adapters to onOpenChange must request close only when next is false.

Composer.domTarget: Outer Box/div takes className; id/name/ref attach to visible textarea. Ref callback preserves React 19 cleanup return. No arbitrary root DOM props. Suggestion ul/li own generated ARIA IDs.
Composer.controlledBehavior: Discriminated controlled value/onValueChange or uncontrolled defaultValue. Internal suggestion/draft/pending/error state; onSubmit receives trimmed nonempty text. Single in-flight submission; fulfillment clears only the unchanged submitted draft, rejection preserves text; stale/unmounted results ignored.
Composer.defaultBehavior: defaultValue empty string, disabled=false; English suggestion/action/recovery labels and keyboard hint are explicit overridable defaults. getSuggestions absent means no suggestions; null/invalid range or stale source closes them. rows=3, suggestion list 280x240px maximum; no mention grammar or serialization built in.

actions.meaning: A rendered slot before the cancel and primary buttons: a second thing to do with the draft, such as the product's Task button, wired by the caller to the draft it keeps through value/onValueChange. Composer does not read or act on it.
actions.migration: Preserve the slot's place before Cancel and the primary action; a change to what Composer does with the draft on a secondary action needs an explicit contract, not a prop rename.
actions.defaultBehavior: Absent: only the optional Cancel and the primary submit button render.

defaultValue.meaning: Discriminated controlled value/onValueChange or uncontrolled defaultValue. Internal suggestion/draft/pending/error state; onSubmit receives trimmed nonempty text. Single in-flight submission; fulfillment clears only the unchanged submitted draft, rejection preserves text; stale/unmounted results ignored.

id.meaning: DOM id of the visible textarea, forwarded through Textarea; suggestion IDs are generated separately.
id.migration: Preserve textarea label/focus integrations; never move this id to outer layout.
id.defaultBehavior: Pass an explicit id when connecting an external label.

onValueChange.meaning: Discriminated controlled value/onValueChange or uncontrolled defaultValue. Internal suggestion/draft/pending/error state; onSubmit receives trimmed nonempty text. Single in-flight submission; fulfillment clears only the unchanged submitted draft, rejection preserves text; stale/unmounted results ignored.

value.meaning: Discriminated controlled value/onValueChange or uncontrolled defaultValue. Internal suggestion/draft/pending/error state; onSubmit receives trimmed nonempty text. Single in-flight submission; fulfillment clears only the unchanged submitted draft, rejection preserves text; stale/unmounted results ignored.

Count.domTarget: span receives native span attributes and events; no ref in the public type.
Count.controlledBehavior: Stateless presentation. The caller owns content and any controls supplied as children; no implicit value, checked or selected state.
Count.defaultBehavior: appearance=default, max=99. Numeric values above max display max+; strings pass through. value is display content, never editable state.

appearance.meaning: Counter emphasis recipe: default, primary, important, added or removed; not a free-form status tone.

value.meaning: Displayed number or string. Numbers above max become max+; this is not an editable value.

DataTable.domTarget: Outer frame div receives className; internal Table receives table metadata label/density, computed grid role and layout. No native rest props/ref; maxHeight targets Table scroll frame.
DataTable.controlledBehavior: The supplied useDataTable instance owns sorting/filtering/pagination/selection/layout; TanStack supports caller-controlled slices through hook options. Renderer reads and requests instance changes. Caller owns state/error/empty and onRowClick effects; no network request is performed.
DataTable.defaultBehavior: state=ready; zero rows while ready resolves empty. Localized missing empty title and error body; toolbar absent renders no toolbar. maxHeight absent leaves natural height (virtualizer initial rect uses 480). Hook defaults selectable/resizable/reorderable/pinRows=false, pinnable/hideable=true, density=default; omitted pageSize shows all rows. Tree/detail/group/reorder/virtualization features are opt-in; options table meta supplies all renderer feature switches.

empty.meaning: Structured recovery content {title, description?, action?}; only shown for explicit empty state or ready with zero rows.
empty.migration: Retain structured recovery contract and ReactNode action slot; do not reinterpret empty as loading or error.
empty.defaultBehavior: Localized Nothing here title if omitted.

DataTable.Columns.domTarget: DropdownMenu trigger and portaled menu. children supplies trigger; no root/ref/native passthrough.
DataTable.Columns.controlledBehavior: Table instance owns column visibility; menu requests visibility toggles. Radix owns menu open state; items stay open when toggled.
DataTable.Columns.defaultBehavior: Default trigger Button uses label or localized Columns and shows visible/total count when columns are hidden. children replaces the trigger. Menu width=220px, align=end. Density and reset controls are in DataTable.Settings.

DataTable.Filter.domTarget: FilterChip trigger and portaled Popover body; no ref/native DOM forwarding. width targets Popover.
DataTable.Filter.controlledBehavior: Local open state owns popover. Column filter value belongs to table instance; range/facet/text edits write immediately. Caller must provide valid column id.
DataTable.Filter.defaultBehavior: width=220px. Label falls back to string column header then column id; unknown column returns null. Column kind chooses range for number/date, facets for short text, substring for long/custom/action content; facet limit=30. Missing filter starts empty; popover starts closed.

width.meaning: Popover content width in CSS pixels.
width.migration: Preserve this family-specific contract; any replacement must retain payload, units and state ownership.

DataTable.Presets.domTarget: Strip: ToggleGroup group and toggle buttons with aria-pressed; className and aria-label target the group. Menu: DropdownMenu with a button trigger; className and aria-label target that trigger. No ref/general DOM forwarding.
DataTable.Presets.controlledBehavior: Table owns column filters; selecting a preset replaces filters. Active id derives from serialized filter equality; no local selection.
DataTable.Presets.defaultBehavior: variant defaults strip. Missing aria-label uses localized Saved questions. A preset without filters means []; no matching preset leaves every toggle unpressed. Counts use rows before global search/pagination.

variant.meaning: Selects a ToggleGroup strip or a DropdownMenu button for the same table-owned preset selection.
variant.migration: Omit to preserve strip presentation; use menu for a compact toolbar. This does not change preset IDs, filter state or counts.

DataTable.Search.domTarget: InputGroup span containing native input; width targets group CSS pixel width. No ref/native DOM forwarding.
DataTable.Search.controlledBehavior: Input is controlled by table.state.globalFilter; typing calls table.setGlobalFilter immediately. No local draft/debounce.
DataTable.Search.defaultBehavior: width=200px; placeholder and accessible name use localized Search; absent globalFilter displays empty string.

width.meaning: InputGroup width in CSS pixels, not a popover preset.
width.migration: Preserve this family-specific contract; any replacement must retain payload, units and state ownership.

DataTable.SelectionBar.domTarget: Named region div; className targets region. No DOM/ref passthrough.
DataTable.SelectionBar.controlledBehavior: Table instance owns selection; clear/Escape reset it. Selecting remaining rows requests toggleAllRowsSelected(true). Caller owns actions and their outcomes.
DataTable.SelectionBar.defaultBehavior: No selected rows returns null. Missing noun uses localized selected count; absent actions still renders Clear. Select all appears only when all page rows are selected, not all rows, and total exceeds visible page.

actions.meaning: Rendered action controls for selected records; the component does not invoke the slot.
actions.migration: Keep ReactNode actions and let each action define its event and async behavior.

DensityProvider.domTarget: Fragment preserving children; no wrapper/ref/DOM forwarding.
DensityProvider.controlledBehavior: Deprecated stateless compatibility no-op; does not own or persist density.
DensityProvider.defaultBehavior: storageKey is intentionally ignored. Children render unchanged; useDensity returns default and no-op setter. Migrate density to Table or useDataTable view.

DensitySwitch.domTarget: ToggleGroup group and native toggle buttons with aria-pressed; className/aria-label target group. No public ref/DOM passthrough.
DensitySwitch.controlledBehavior: Deprecated controlled standalone control; value/onChange only. Does not read a provider or change document/table density.
DensitySwitch.defaultBehavior: value=default, onChange=no-op, showLabels=false, aria-label=Row density. Visible labels Comfortable/Compact are legacy English copy.

value.meaning: Legacy controlled Density value; no provider or table connection.
value.migration: Migrate to Table density or DataTable Columns menu; preserve caller state if temporarily retaining control.

onChange.meaning: Legacy Density notification, not native event and not persistence.
onChange.migration: Move density ownership to the table view; do not mount the deprecated provider to wire it.

Dot.domTarget: SVG circle: supplied label makes a named image; otherwise aria-hidden. No native prop/ref bag.
Dot.controlledBehavior: Stateless presentation. The caller owns content and any controls supplied as children; no implicit value, checked or selected state.
Dot.defaultBehavior: tone=neutral; fixed 6px size, caller className can style it.

tone.meaning: Semantic tone from the component allowed union; neutral is not a category hue. Uses the family tone styling described above.

DragContext.domTarget: Context provider preserves child structure; DndContext also supplies accessibility live regions/instructions. No wrapper/ref/native DOM API.
DragContext.controlledBehavior: Dnd-kit owns transient drag state. Column drop requests table.setColumnOrder; row drop invokes table meta reorderRows with originals and before/after, leaving data updates to caller. Sortable sets derive ids from the same instance.
DragContext.defaultBehavior: Pointer sensor requires 8px movement; keyboard sensor uses sortable coordinates. Motion constrained horizontally for columns and vertically for rows; closest-center collision. No public sensor defaults override.

Editable.Select.domTarget: Outer div with internal edit trigger; Editable.Text swaps button for native input while editing. No public DOM/ref forwarding. label names the internal control and generated IDs associate errors.
Editable.Select.controlledBehavior: Caller owns committed value/onChange; internal draft/edit/save state. Optimistic onChange(next), save promise, and rollback on rejection only while operation still owns that value. Synchronous save throws become rejection; duplicate saves suppressed; unmounted/stale results ignored.
Editable.Select.defaultBehavior: No default committed value. Text draft initializes from value; no validation means valid; unchanged commits skip save. Empty text displays placeholder or Absent. Select render defaults to raw value; menu width=220px. Saved state lasts 1400ms; localized generic failure when rejection is not Error.

onChange.meaning: Caller owns committed value/onChange; internal draft/edit/save state. Optimistic onChange(next), save promise, and rollback on rejection only while operation still owns that value. Synchronous save throws become rejection; duplicate saves suppressed; unmounted/stale results ignored.

value.meaning: Caller owns committed value/onChange; internal draft/edit/save state. Optimistic onChange(next), save promise, and rollback on rejection only while operation still owns that value. Synchronous save throws become rejection; duplicate saves suppressed; unmounted/stale results ignored.

Editable.Text.domTarget: Outer div with internal edit trigger; Editable.Text swaps button for native input while editing. No public DOM/ref forwarding. label names the internal control and generated IDs associate errors.
Editable.Text.controlledBehavior: Caller owns committed value/onChange; internal draft/edit/save state. Optimistic onChange(next), save promise, and rollback on rejection only while operation still owns that value. Synchronous save throws become rejection; duplicate saves suppressed; unmounted/stale results ignored.
Editable.Text.defaultBehavior: No default committed value. Text draft initializes from value; no validation means valid; unchanged commits skip save. Empty text displays placeholder or Absent. Select render defaults to raw value; menu width=220px. Saved state lasts 1400ms; localized generic failure when rejection is not Error.

onChange.meaning: Caller owns committed value/onChange; internal draft/edit/save state. Optimistic onChange(next), save promise, and rollback on rejection only while operation still owns that value. Synchronous save throws become rejection; duplicate saves suppressed; unmounted/stale results ignored.

value.meaning: Caller owns committed value/onChange; internal draft/edit/save state. Optimistic onChange(next), save promise, and rollback on rejection only while operation still owns that value. Synchronous save throws become rejection; duplicate saves suppressed; unmounted/stale results ignored.

Empty.domTarget: Root div with two composition layouts; title renders as p. No DOM attributes or ref passthrough.
Empty.controlledBehavior: Stateless empty-state presentation; action slots own any interactions.
Empty.defaultBehavior: size defaults to default (dashed frame); compact is unframed and places the icon beside content. Omitted/falsy icon, description or actions omit their wrappers. Valid icon elements are cloned with component-owned sizing className; other ReactNode content is retained inside aria-hidden mark.

action.meaning: Rendered action content in its named position; the pattern does not clone it or invoke it as a callback.
action.migration: Keep caller-composed controls and their event ownership; do not replace this ReactNode slot with a callback or action configuration.

icon.meaning: Decorative ReactNode mark. Valid elements receive a replacement className for size; the enclosing mark is aria-hidden.
icon.migration: Keep supplied icon content decorative and put essential information in title/description. Do not migrate to an icon constructor without an explicit adapter.

size.meaning: Composition choice: default is a framed vertical empty region; compact is a horizontal unframed inset composition.
size.migration: Keep these family-specific layout values; do not equate default/compact with control heights.

Eyebrow.domTarget: as chooses a TextElement or h2/h3/h4; id and className reach that element. No arbitrary DOM/ref forwarding.
Eyebrow.controlledBehavior: Stateless presentation. The caller owns content and any controls supplied as children; no implicit value, checked or selected state.
Eyebrow.defaultBehavior: as=div, tone=neutral. Fixed uppercase eyebrow typography; omitted children render an empty element.

id.meaning: An id, so a list can be labelled by its eyebrow.

tone.meaning: Semantic tone from the component allowed union; neutral is not a category hue. Uses the family tone styling described above.

Fact.domTarget: div containing dt and dd. Compose inside Fact.Group dl; no arbitrary DOM/ref forwarding.
Fact.controlledBehavior: Stateless presentation. The caller owns content and any controls supplied as children; no implicit value, checked or selected state.
Fact.defaultBehavior: Label and children are caller content; no empty placeholder or inferred value. Each fact uses the fixed horizontal label/value layout.

Fact.Group.domTarget: dl wraps Fact items; no arbitrary DOM/ref forwarding.
Fact.Group.controlledBehavior: Stateless presentation. The caller owns content and any controls supplied as children; no implicit value, checked or selected state.
Fact.Group.defaultBehavior: Default layout is the fixed wrapping fact row; children determine ordering.

FilterChip.domTarget: Native button receives remaining button props/events; no public ref. label/value compose the content.
FilterChip.controlledBehavior: isActive and disabled are caller-owned. isActive supplies aria-pressed unless aria-expanded or aria-haspopup gives the control popover semantics. onClick belongs to the caller.
FilterChip.defaultBehavior: Native type defaults to button; omitted isActive/disabled are false. Optional value is displayed after label, not a native form value. Children are not a replacement label; use label/value.

value.meaning: Optional displayed filter value appended to label, not the native button form value.

Flex.domTarget: The actual as element receives native attributes/events and HTMLElement ref. id remains a DOM id. Polymorphic element choices are restricted to documented semantic tags.
Flex.controlledBehavior: Stateless presentation. The caller owns content and any controls supplied as children; no implicit value, checked or selected state.
Flex.defaultBehavior: as=div. CSS defaults to row, nowrap, stretch alignment and normal justification. No gap without a token. Style prop is intentionally excluded.

Gates.domTarget: ul containing Gates.Item rows; no arbitrary DOM/ref forwarding.
Gates.controlledBehavior: Stateless presentation. The caller owns content and any controls supplied as children; no implicit value, checked or selected state.
Gates.defaultBehavior: Children determine order and content. No aggregate met calculation or default empty UI.

Gates.Item.domTarget: li with met/unmet icon and text; action is a caller-owned ReactNode slot. No arbitrary DOM/ref forwarding.
Gates.Item.controlledBehavior: Required met is caller-owned boolean. The component never evaluates business rules or executes the action itself.
Gates.Item.defaultBehavior: tone=warning applies to unmet entries. Met uses success check styling. reason and action are optional; spoken Met/Not met text is fixed English in this version.

action.meaning: The one thing that meets it, at the end of the row: a link Button or a TextLink.

tone.meaning: Semantic tone from the component allowed union; neutral is not a category hue. Uses the family tone styling described above.

Glance.domTarget: div of visible record facts; id renders through Id and title through Text. No DOM/ref forwarding.
Glance.controlledBehavior: Stateless record summary; caller supplies values and status.
Glance.defaultBehavior: facts defaults to []; at most the first four are rendered in order with fixed 88px KeyValue label width. Title clamps to two lines and meta to one. Falsy status/meta omit their wrappers.

id.meaning: Rendered record identifier, not an HTML id or label-target attribute.
id.migration: Keep domain identity as visible content; use underlying primitives when DOM attribute/ref integration is required.

Grid.domTarget: The actual as element receives native attributes/events and HTMLElement ref. id remains a DOM id. Box/Grid accept style; Polymorphic element choices are restricted to documented semantic tags.
Grid.controlledBehavior: Stateless presentation. The caller owns content and any controls supplied as children; no implicit value, checked or selected state.
Grid.defaultBehavior: as=div. Template columns can be static or responsive; template rows/areas use inline styles. Caller style overrides computed templates. No gap or explicit columns when omitted.

HeaderMenu.domTarget: IconButton trigger and portaled DropdownMenu; returns null when sort/pin/hide unavailable. No ref/native passthrough.
HeaderMenu.controlledBehavior: Table/column instance owns sorting/pinning/visibility; items request changes. Radix owns open state.
HeaderMenu.defaultBehavior: Menu width=200px, align=end. Trigger label derives from string header then column id. pin/hide requires both table feature and column permission; sort requires column permission.

Heading.domTarget: The actual as element receives native attributes/events and HTMLElement ref. id remains a DOM id. Polymorphic element choices are restricted to documented semantic tags.
Heading.controlledBehavior: Stateless presentation. The caller owns content and any controls supplied as children; no implicit value, checked or selected state.
Heading.defaultBehavior: size is required. Default tag: large=div, medium=h1, small=h2, xsmall=h3; as overrides it. Omitted color inherits. Style prop is intentionally excluded.

size.meaning: Required heading typography scale also selects default semantic tag; large intentionally defaults to div.

IconButton.domTarget: Button action target; native button by default. Custom rendered controls must forward props and refs.
IconButton.controlledBehavior: Delegates activation, disabled and loading behavior to Button.
IconButton.defaultBehavior: secondary, small (28px), type=button. Required label names the control and its optional tooltip; icon is decorative.

icon.meaning: The icon, passed bare; the button sizes it.

size.meaning: `small` (28px) is the default, for toolbars and rows; `medium` (32px) sits beside medium controls.

variant.meaning: `secondary` is the raised button; `subtle` sits in toolbars and rows; `primary` is the bold fill, for the chevron of a primary split button.

Id.domTarget: span containing visible identifier text; className/style reach the span. It has no DOM id prop.
Id.controlledBehavior: Stateless presentation. The caller owns content and any controls supplied as children; no implicit value, checked or selected state.
Id.defaultBehavior: Inherits surrounding font and adds tabular numerals; no prefix, parsing or empty fallback.

Id.List.domTarget: span containing displayed identifier spans, or the empty string fallback. No arbitrary DOM/ref forwarding.
Id.List.controlledBehavior: Stateless presentation. The caller owns content and any controls supplied as children; no implicit value, checked or selected state.
Id.List.defaultBehavior: empty defaults to an em dash. ids is caller data, not HTML ids; empty array renders the fallback. Ordering follows the array.

ids.meaning: Ordered domain identifiers displayed as content; these are not HTML element ids.
ids.migration: Retain plural data semantics and do not confuse with DOM integration id.

empty.meaning: String fallback, default em dash, for a compact sequence of identifiers.
empty.migration: Retain the small content contract; a full recovery action belongs to a containing Empty pattern.

IndexPage.domTarget: Layout div; header and children render directly and filters get a wrapping div. No DOM/ref forwarding.
IndexPage.controlledBehavior: Stateless page composition; header, filter and table state belong to caller-supplied children.
IndexPage.defaultBehavior: Falsy/omitted filters create no toolbar wrapper. No built-in selection, filtering or empty-state inference.

Indicator.domTarget: span receives native span attributes and events; nested Dot is decorative. No public ref.
Indicator.controlledBehavior: Stateless presentation. The caller owns content and any controls supplied as children; no implicit value, checked or selected state.
Indicator.defaultBehavior: tone=neutral. Neutral uses subtle text; other tones retain default text with colored Dot. No selectable/toggle behavior.

tone.meaning: Semantic tone from the component allowed union; neutral is not a category hue. Uses the family tone styling described above.

Inline.domTarget: The actual as element receives native attributes/events and HTMLElement ref. id remains a DOM id. Polymorphic element choices are restricted to documented semantic tags.
Inline.controlledBehavior: Stateless presentation. The caller owns content and any controls supplied as children; no implicit value, checked or selected state.
Inline.defaultBehavior: as=div, display=flex. CSS row/nowrap, no gap unless supplied. rowSpace falls back to space; spread overrides alignInline. grow omitted hugs content. separator is decorative and omitted for ul/ol to preserve list semantics. Style prop is intentionally excluded.

Inspector.domTarget: Div root; sticky form nests ScrollArea. Accordion owns the coordinated sections and KeyValue owns rows. No arbitrary DOM/ref forwarding.
Inspector.controlledBehavior: Each group is an uncontrolled disclosure open initially; caller supplies facts, not disclosure state. PanelContext supplies flush and default stickiness. Titles are disclosure identity and React keys and must be unique.
Inspector.defaultBehavior: Sticky defaults outside Panel; flush defaults false. Root multiple defaultValue explicitly opens all supplied titles. Titles remain the Inspector adapter identity and React keys and must be unique. Falsy footer is omitted.

Inspector.Group.domTarget: Collapsible root with its trigger and body; no extra landmark or DOM/ref passthrough.
Inspector.Group.controlledBehavior: Uncontrolled independent Collapsible, initially open. Accordion ancestry does not change ownership. PanelContext controls inset geometry.
Inspector.Group.defaultBehavior: defaultOpen=true. Panel flush controls inset body spacing. Action remains at the top end of the body. No parent scans this wrapper for initial selection.

action.meaning: Rendered action content in its named position; the pattern does not clone it or invoke it as a callback.
action.migration: Keep caller-composed controls and their event ownership; do not replace this ReactNode slot with a callback or action configuration.

Item.domTarget: Outer li belongs inside Item.Group ol. Link/title button receives generated title id; actions are sibling controls. No arbitrary DOM/ref forwarding.
Item.controlledBehavior: When isCollapsible and children are truthy, Radix Collapsible owns uncontrolled open state or follows open/onOpenChange. defaultOpen initializes once. onSelect makes a title button; link takes precedence. isActive is caller-owned styling.
Item.defaultBehavior: defaultOpen=false. Standalone context is default size/non-flush; idWidth=72px. Noncollapsible children render statically. Link children/className/id are composed by Item, including replacing the link id. id is displayed record content, not DOM identity.

actions.meaning: Buttons at the end of the row, beside the row's link or button, never inside it.

defaultOpen.meaning: Initial uncontrolled expansion, false by default; not resynchronized after mount.

id.meaning: Displayed record identifier, not an HTML id. The title gets an internal generated DOM id.

onOpenChange.meaning: Radix expansion request callback receiving boolean; controlled callers must update open.

onSelect.meaning: Optional title activation callback. A supplied link takes precedence; this does not select or expand internal state.

open.meaning: Controlled expansion state used only when isCollapsible and children are truthy.

Item.Group.domTarget: Outer div, optional h3 header and ol; empty content uses a div instead of ol. aria-labelledby uses title heading id or supplied labelledBy. No arbitrary DOM/ref forwarding.
Item.Group.controlledBehavior: Stateless presentation. The caller owns content and any controls supplied as children; no implicit value, checked or selected state.
