Stat.Tile.defaultBehavior: tone=neutral. Numeric 0 or string "0" uses muted text regardless of tone. Stat.Tile adds the optional note slot; no default placeholder or number formatting.

tone.meaning: Semantic tone from the component allowed union; neutral is not a category hue. Uses the family tone styling described above.

value.meaning: Rendered statistic content; no internal number formatting or input state. Numeric/string zero is muted.

Stepper.domTarget: ol with optional aria-label and caller style. No arbitrary DOM/ref forwarding.
Stepper.controlledBehavior: Root derives index/count and preceding-done context from direct children; each Item state is caller-owned. It does not advance steps or select them automatically.
Stepper.defaultBehavior: orientation=horizontal, numbered=false. Horizontal minWidth=420px unless caller style overrides it. Use direct Stepper.Item children for indexing; arbitrary wrappers/fragments are not introspected.

Stepper.Item.domTarget: li with aria-current=step when current; button when onSelect exists, otherwise span. No arbitrary DOM/ref forwarding.
Stepper.Item.controlledBehavior: Required state is caller-owned done/current/upcoming/blocked. onSelect is optional activation and does not mutate state or implement tabs/roving focus.
Stepper.Item.defaultBehavior: Standalone context starts index=0/count=1/numbered=false. first/last are deprecated and ignored; root context defines positions. Spoken state prefixes are fixed English. Optional children render beside the title control.

onSelect.meaning: Optional step activation callback; caller owns step state. No automatic progression.

Table.domTarget: table receives native props/className/style/id/role. frameRef targets the outer scroll div, whose maxHeight/density and overflow keyboard affordance are package-owned. No public table ref prop.
Table.controlledBehavior: Caller owns content/density; local DOM tracking detects scroll position and overflow to expose a focusable named region/group. No sort or selection state exists at root.
Table.defaultBehavior: density absent resolves ordinary CSS row density; compact sets data-density on the frame. Missing maxHeight only enables horizontal overflow; provided number sets CSS pixel maxHeight. No default label/role/id/native callbacks; native aria-label can override label on table, while label also names the scroll frame.

Table.Cell.domTarget: td; native props/id/style target td; no public ref.
Table.Cell.controlledBehavior: Stateless presentation; caller owns row/column data and native event effects. Inherited React defaultValue/defaultChecked and media/change event names are DOM compatibility surface, not table state APIs.
Table.Cell.defaultBehavior: pinned overrides sticky; offset defaults 0. Missing width uses content/native style; string child provides title unless native title overrides it.

width.meaning: Column width in CSS pixels composed into cell style; explicit style.width can override it.
width.migration: Preserve numeric pixel semantics and style precedence; do not rename to a control size preset.
width.defaultBehavior: Absent width leaves caller/native table layout.

Table.Detail.domTarget: tr receives id; spanning td receives className/colSpan/content. No ref/native rest props.
Table.Detail.controlledBehavior: Stateless; caller owns mounting/expansion and aria-controls linkage.
Table.Detail.defaultBehavior: id absent means no DOM id; required colSpan from visible columns. Always renders when mounted; caller mounts based on expansion.

id.meaning: DOM id on the detail tr for a disclosure trigger aria-controls.
id.migration: Keep stable and unique per mounted table; do not replace with displayed record text.

Table.Group.domTarget: tbody containing group header tr/td and nested toggle button. No DOM/ref passthrough.
Table.Group.controlledBehavior: Fully controlled open; header click or toggle button requests onToggle exactly once. Caller updates open; no defaultOpen/local state.
Table.Group.defaultBehavior: open/title/colSpan/onToggle required. Children render only when open; count uses truthy display (zero omitted), trailing omitted if absent.

open.meaning: Caller-owned group expansion controlling child row mounting.
open.migration: Preserve this family-specific contract; any replacement must retain payload, units and state ownership.

Table.Handle.domTarget: td containing span role=button; ref/native props/className target span, not td.
Table.Handle.controlledBehavior: Stateless presentation; caller owns row/column data and native event effects. Inherited React defaultValue/defaultChecked and media/change event names are DOM compatibility surface, not table state APIs. Dnd-kit caller owns drag behavior and accessibility attributes.
Table.Handle.defaultBehavior: label uses localized Reorder; isDragging absent false. The caller supplies drag listeners, tabIndex and aria attributes; the component does not invent drag state.

Table.Header.domTarget: th and nested sort button/resize separator; ref targets th. Native props/id/style target th, not nested controls.
Table.Header.controlledBehavior: Stateless presentation; caller owns row/column data and native event effects. Inherited React defaultValue/defaultChecked and media/change event names are DOM compatibility surface, not table state APIs. sort and resize.value are caller-owned; onSort/onResizeKeyboard only request changes.
Table.Header.defaultBehavior: pinned overrides sticky; sticky alone pins start, offset defaults 0, width absent leaves style width alone. sort or onSort creates sort button; no callbacks are synthesized. resize/trailing absent renders no handles/actions. Header is vertically sticky by default.

width.meaning: Column width in CSS pixels composed into cell style; explicit style.width can override it.
width.migration: Preserve numeric pixel semantics and style precedence; do not rename to a control size preset.
width.defaultBehavior: Absent width leaves caller/native table layout.

Table.Id.domTarget: td containing Id span and optional preview button; id is displayed ReactNode record content, not DOM id. No ref/general DOM spread.
Table.Id.controlledBehavior: Caller owns active preview and preview outcome. Preview click stops row propagation and calls onPreview; it does not toggle internal state.
Table.Id.defaultBehavior: tone=brand; isActive absent false; no preview button without onPreview. Width absent defers to table layout; pinning offset defaults 0.

id.meaning: Displayed record identifier ReactNode inside Id typography, not an HTML id.
id.migration: Keep distinct from DOM identity; do not pass it to an element id attribute.

tone.meaning: Preview affordance emphasis: brand lights up on row hover; subtle does not. isActive independently forces brand.
tone.migration: Preserve this family-specific contract; any replacement must retain payload, units and state ownership.

width.meaning: CSS pixel width on the containing td for a headerless table.
width.migration: Preserve this family-specific contract; any replacement must retain payload, units and state ownership.

Table.Row.domTarget: tr; ref and native props target tr.
Table.Row.controlledBehavior: Stateless presentation; caller owns row/column data and native event effects. Inherited React defaultValue/defaultChecked and media/change event names are DOM compatibility surface, not table state APIs.
Table.Row.defaultBehavior: isSelected/isStatic absent are false. Hover is enabled except isStatic; selected changes data-selected and colors without toggling selection.

Table.Tree.domTarget: td containing indented name and optional toggle button; className targets td. No DOM/ref passthrough.
Table.Tree.controlledBehavior: Caller owns expanded and tree hierarchy; optional onToggle reports request only. Containing treegrid and rows must provide tree aria/key navigation.
Table.Tree.defaultBehavior: hasChildren=false, expanded=false; depth required (space.200 per level). No children toggle when hasChildren is false; missing hint adds nothing.

TaskRow.domTarget: Item li with separate Checkbox, title link/button/span and action slots; only Item-picked className/meta/actions/link/onSelect are forwarded. No DOM id/aria/ref passthrough.
TaskRow.controlledBehavior: completed is caller-controlled presentation and checkbox state. onCompletedChange requests boolean updates; no optimistic state or persistence. Item handles independent link/onSelect interactions; link takes precedence. Item.Group owns density/flush context.
TaskRow.defaultBehavior: completed and completionDisabled default false; completedLabel defaults Completed. Omitted onCompletedChange removes checkbox; completed rows then add hidden completed text. completionLabel nullishly falls back to Complete/Reopen plus title. dueDateTime truthiness creates time only when due is non-nullish. Omitted assignee/due/status creates no trailing group.

actions.meaning: Rendered action content in its named position; the pattern does not clone it or invoke it as a callback.
actions.migration: Keep caller-composed controls and their event ownership; do not replace this ReactNode slot with a callback or action configuration.

onCompletedChange.meaning: Optional boolean request callback; presence creates a controlled Base UI Checkbox.
onCompletedChange.migration: Preserve caller-controlled completion and optional control; product status vocabulary or async saving belongs outside this primitive.

onSelect.meaning: Optional zero-argument title activation callback inherited from Item, independent of completion. Suppressed by a supplied link.
onSelect.migration: Retain separate completion and navigation actions; avoid nested interactive targets or changing to a DOM event callback.

Text.domTarget: The actual as element receives native attributes/events and HTMLElement ref. id remains a DOM id. Polymorphic element choices are restricted to documented semantic tags.
Text.controlledBehavior: Stateless presentation. The caller owns content and any controls supplied as children; no implicit value, checked or selected state.
Text.defaultBehavior: as=span. Omitted size/weight/color/align inherit; no truncation without maxLines. htmlFor associates a control when as=label. Style prop is intentionally excluded.

size.meaning: Composite body typography scale: large, medium, small or xsmall; omitted inherits, not a control height.

TextLink.domTarget: Single Slot child by default, native anchor with asChild=false. Anchor props/events spread to that target; public type excludes ref.
TextLink.controlledBehavior: Stateless presentation. The caller owns content and any controls supplied as children; no implicit value, checked or selected state.
TextLink.defaultBehavior: asChild=true requires one compatible child. Omitted size/weight inherit text; size only allows small/medium. No default href or navigation callback; caller supplies link behavior.

size.meaning: Left unset, the link takes the surrounding size.

Tiles.domTarget: Grid div; no arbitrary DOM/ref forwarding.
Tiles.controlledBehavior: Stateless presentation. The caller owns content and any controls supplied as children; no implicit value, checked or selected state.
Tiles.defaultBehavior: cols=4 and frame=card. Base layout has two columns; responsive breakpoints realize requested 2..6 columns. band selects a shared bordered frame, not a size. Tiles is a deprecated exact alias for Stat.Grid.

Timeline.domTarget: ol with context and optional aria-label; no arbitrary DOM/ref forwarding.
Timeline.controlledBehavior: Stateless presentation. The caller owns content and any controls supplied as children; no implicit value, checked or selected state.
Timeline.defaultBehavior: orientation=vertical, size=medium (20px), align=center. Vertical timePosition defaults end; horizontal coerces every position except below to above and has 420px minimum width. Groups are vertical only.

size.meaning: Marker/row scale: small=16px, medium=20px, large=24px, not an overall list height.

Timeline.Group.domTarget: li with sticky heading and nested ol named by generated heading id. No arbitrary DOM/ref forwarding.
Timeline.Group.controlledBehavior: Stateless presentation. The caller owns content and any controls supplied as children; no implicit value, checked or selected state.
Timeline.Group.defaultBehavior: Vertical timeline context supplies geometry. Numeric count includes zero. label/children are required; no expansion or item counting is inferred.

Timeline.Item.domTarget: li with marker/title/body regions. Title clones link with generated id or renders onSelect button, else span. No arbitrary DOM/ref forwarding.
Timeline.Item.controlledBehavior: isActive/emphasis are caller-owned presentation. onSelect invokes an action only; link wins when both are supplied. No automatic unread/completion state.
Timeline.Item.defaultBehavior: tone=neutral. marker overrides icon overrides Dot/ring. Parent context sets scale/time position; standalone fallback matches vertical medium/end/center. dateTime only creates a time element when time is supplied. Link id/children/className are composed by the item.

icon.meaning: An icon in the marker, passed bare: a check for done, a cross for failed, a play for running. The marker becomes a disc in the tone with the icon on it.

onSelect.meaning: Title activation callback. A supplied link takes precedence; caller updates any active/unread state.

tone.meaning: Semantic tone from the component allowed union; neutral is not a category hue. Uses the family tone styling described above.

Toaster.domTarget: Sonner section containing toast lists, rendered in place with fixed positioning. Public props expose only position, expand and closeButton, not arbitrary DOM/ref attributes.
Toaster.controlledBehavior: Sonner store owns queue, dismissal and timers. Exported toast methods enqueue notifications; component props configure presentation. Promise/error behavior delegates through the package toast adapter.
Toaster.defaultBehavior: position=bottom-right, expand=false, closeButton=false; fixed gap=8, offset=16, visibleToasts=4. Locale supplies direction/messages. toast.error defaults duration=8000 and closeButton=true, then caller options override those defaults.

Toolbar.domTarget: Outer layout div; className targets it. Search is internal Input; actions is a trailing span slot. No generic root DOM/ref forwarding.
Toolbar.controlledBehavior: Search shown only with onSearch callback and is controlled by search; no internal query state. Caller owns filters and actions.
Toolbar.defaultBehavior: Missing search falls back to empty string; placeholder and accessible name fall back to localized search. Search is small at width 200px. Falsy actions omitted.

actions.meaning: ReactNode action content rendered at the trailing edge; not a callback or data list.
actions.migration: Retain composable content slot and let each supplied action own its event handler.

Tree.domTarget: Root div role=tree with private ref; label supplies accessible name, className styles root. No generic DOM/ref API.
Tree.controlledBehavior: Caller owns flattened visible data and row expanded/selected state. Root manages roving focus, typeahead and inferred sibling metadata; it does not update caller selection.
Tree.defaultBehavior: size=small (32px), xsmall=24px. Tab entry chooses focused row, preceding surviving row after removal, selected row, then first. Explicit row posInSet/setSize override inference; typeahead buffer lasts 700ms.

size.meaning: Row density small=32px/xsmall=24px; family-specific names intentionally differ from control size.
size.migration: Keep family-relative geometry and native attribute exceptions explicit; no global enum normalization.

Tree.Item.domTarget: div role=treeitem with branch button hidden from accessibility/tab order; className targets row. No generic id/ref API.
Tree.Item.controlledBehavior: expanded/isSelected are caller-owned; onToggle() requests expansion, onSelect() requests selection. Root owns roving tabIndex; trailing controls stop row click propagation.
Tree.Item.defaultBehavior: hasChildren/expanded/isSelected=false. Size inherits Tree or small; guides default to every ancestor depth. ARIA level=depth+1. Without callbacks state does not change; explicit sibling metadata retained.

onSelect.meaning: expanded/isSelected are caller-owned; onToggle() requests expansion, onSelect() requests selection. Root owns roving tabIndex; trailing controls stop row click propagation.

WorkPane.domTarget: Grid div containing an aside navigation list and detail div. useId links listLabel to aside; no DOM/ref passthrough.
WorkPane.controlledBehavior: Caller owns chosen detail and row activation. WorkPane only supplies Item.Group compact density; no selected-id or internal detail state.
WorkPane.defaultBehavior: Truthy listWidth overrides layout-list CSS variable in pixels; omitted/0 uses token default 340px. listLabel truthiness selects generated aria-labelledby or literal List aria-label. detail ?? empty uses empty only for null/undefined, not false or zero. Layout stacks below lg.

empty.meaning: Fallback ReactNode for null/undefined detail; false explicitly renders an empty detail area without fallback.
empty.migration: Preserve nullish fallback semantics and caller-selected detail; do not infer from row count or visibility.

WorkPane.Row.domTarget: Item li with title button and visible Id in description, not a DOM id. No DOM/ref passthrough.
WorkPane.Row.controlledBehavior: Caller owns isActive and onSelect; callback activates in place without changing internal state. Item.Group controls density/flush when present.
WorkPane.Row.defaultBehavior: tone defaults neutral. isActive omitted is unhighlighted. Dot renders before title; caller meta must carry semantic status text when color is meaningful. Falsy meta omits its span.

id.meaning: Rendered record identifier, not an HTML id or label-target attribute.
id.migration: Keep domain identity as visible content; use underlying primitives when DOM attribute/ref integration is required.

tone.meaning: Semantic Dot paint before title using Tone; neutral by default. This does not generate a status word.
tone.migration: Keep visual semantic tone and caller-provided readable status together; do not reinterpret as decorative identity hue.

onSelect.meaning: Required zero-argument callback from Item title button; no navigation or selected-id update is automatic.
onSelect.migration: Keep caller-managed selected record and detail; use Item link API for navigation instead of changing this callback payload.

Accordion.domTarget: Root div; native attributes, events, className, style and ref forwarded; asChild composes one child. dir follows LedgerProvider unless explicit.
Accordion.controlledBehavior: Root controls string selection in single mode or string-array selection in multiple mode, with value/onValueChange or initial defaultValue. No coercion or child inspection.
Accordion.defaultBehavior: type required. Closed without initial selection. Single requires collapsible to close its open item; multiple permits independent toggles. disabled defaults false.

defaultValue.meaning: Root controls string selection in single mode or string-array selection in multiple mode, with value/onValueChange or initial defaultValue. No coercion or child inspection.
defaultValue.migration: Choose type explicitly and matching string/string[] root values; provide stable item values. Old Group defaulted to multiple; old Accordion defaulted to single and collapsible.

onValueChange.meaning: Root controls string selection in single mode or string-array selection in multiple mode, with value/onValueChange or initial defaultValue. No coercion or child inspection.
onValueChange.migration: Choose type explicitly and matching string/string[] root values; provide stable item values. Old Group defaulted to multiple; old Accordion defaulted to single and collapsible.

value.meaning: Root controls string selection in single mode or string-array selection in multiple mode, with value/onValueChange or initial defaultValue. No coercion or child inspection.
value.migration: Choose type explicitly and matching string/string[] root values; provide stable item values. Old Group defaulted to multiple; old Accordion defaulted to single and collapsible.

Accordion.Content.domTarget: Content div and named region; attributes/events/ref forwarded. Radix associates it with the trigger.
Accordion.Content.controlledBehavior: Follows owning item; forceMount retains mounted state while closed-state CSS hides content and excludes controls from tab order.
Accordion.Content.defaultBehavior: Unmounts after exit animation normally. forceMount absent by default; retained closed panels hide immediately. Reduced-motion support, no body spacing or browser-find support.

id.meaning: Native DOM ID on the named part; Radix supplies trigger/content association IDs when omitted. Item selection identity is separate.
id.migration: Keep DOM IDs separate from item values and preserve ARIA associations when overriding IDs.

Accordion.Header.domTarget: h3 by default; native attributes/events/ref forwarded. asChild permits an appropriate semantic heading.
Accordion.Header.controlledBehavior: No local state; wraps the trigger in the document outline.
Accordion.Header.defaultBehavior: Default h3 with flex layout; no ancestor-inferred level or text.

Accordion.Item.domTarget: Item div; native attributes/events/ref forwarded. Required value is stable selection identity, distinct from native id.
Accordion.Item.controlledBehavior: Root owns selection; no item open/defaultOpen state API. Item disabled disables its trigger.
Accordion.Item.defaultBehavior: value required, disabled false. No inferred title, identity or border.

value.meaning: Required stable string selection identity, independent of display text, position and native id.
value.migration: Use explicit stable values; replace child defaultOpen with root defaultValue.

Accordion.Trigger.domTarget: Native button; attributes/events/ref forwarded. asChild composes one ref-capable child and uses its complete content.
Accordion.Trigger.controlledBehavior: Radix toggles its item according to root selection and disabled state. Native onChange does not report expansion.
Accordion.Trigger.defaultBehavior: Token focus/hover/typography with decorative chevron. indicator replaces it, null hides it; asChild supplies complete presentation.

id.meaning: Native DOM ID on the named part; Radix supplies trigger/content association IDs when omitted. Item selection identity is separate.
id.migration: Keep DOM IDs separate from item values and preserve ARIA associations when overriding IDs.

DataTable.Settings.domTarget: DropdownMenu trigger and portaled menu. children replaces the default labelled IconButton; no root/ref/native passthrough.
DataTable.Settings.controlledBehavior: Table metadata owns density and view. Menu requests density toggles via setDensity and reset via resetView(table). Radix owns menu open state.
DataTable.Settings.defaultBehavior: Default secondary small gear IconButton uses label or localized Table settings. Menu width=220px and align=end. Density defaults to default; density option exists only with setDensity and stays open when toggled. Reset label depends on a named view.
